definitions.gloss: writing on behalf of another, ghostwriting
definitions.explanation: The act of writing something in place of another person, either because they cannot write themselves or because they have asked someone else to write for them.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}に{手紙|てがみ}を{代筆|だいひつ}した。
examples.english: I wrote a letter on behalf of my mother.

examples.japanese: {怪我|けが}で{右手|みぎて}が{使|つか}えないので、{友人|ゆうじん}に{代筆|だいひつ}を{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: Since I couldn't use my right hand due to an injury, I asked a friend to write for me.

examples.japanese: この{小説|しょうせつ}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{作家|さっか}の{名前|なまえ}で{出|で}たが、{実|じつ}は{代筆|だいひつ}だったらしい。
examples.english: This novel came out under a famous author's name, but apparently it was ghostwritten.

notes:
USAGE:
Covers both practical situations (writing for someone who is injured or illiterate) and professional ghostwriting. Can be used as a noun or with する.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代筆|だいひつ}する (to write on behalf of)
- {代筆|だいひつ}を{頼|たの}む (to ask someone to write for you)
- {代筆|だいひつ}{者|しゃ} (ghostwriter, scribe)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ゴーストライター: ghostwriter — specifically for professional authorship
- {代書|だいしょ}: writing official documents on behalf of another (more formal/legal)
